newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Strong beef and live market should support October. Rising placements negative to deferred months.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Lower corn futures should offset easier index.
LIVE HOGS - Up 0.100 to off 0.200 cent. Live seen steady to firm but expected larger runs later in week bearish.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.100 to 0.300 cent. Carryover technical pressure after limit down close Friday.
